title: Contact Page
content: Build contact page. Two-column layout: contact form left, info right. Form: name, email, subject dropdown, message textarea, submit button. Validation: required fields, email format. Contact info: email, phone, address with icons. Office hours. Map embed. Social links. FAQ link. Response time expectation. Success state: thank you message.

variants.simple: Create contact page with form, contact info, and map.
variants.detailed: Build contact page. Two-column layout: contact form left, info right. Form: name, email, subject dropdown, message textarea, submit button. Validation: required fields, email format. Contact info: email, phone, address with icons. Office hours. Map embed. Social links. FAQ link. Response time expectation. Success state: thank you message.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive contact page with multiple contact methods. Page header: "Get in Touch" (text-4xl font-bold), subheadline "We would love to hear from you" (text-xl text-gray-600). Layout: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 max-w-6xl mx-auto py-16 px-4. Contact form card: bg-white rounded-xl shadow-lg p-8. Form fields: name (text input, required), email (email input, required with format validation), phone (tel input, optional), company (text input, optional), subject dropdown (General Inquiry, Support, Sales, Partnership, Other), message (textarea, rows-6, required, character count). Submit button: w-full, loading state with spinner, disabled when submitting. Validation: inline errors (text-red-600 text-sm), real-time for email format, on submit for required. Success state: replace form with success message (CheckCircle icon, "Thank you for your message!", "We'll get back to you within 24 hours", "Send another message" link). Contact info column: space-y-8. Info cards: each with icon, label, value. Email: Mail icon, email address (clickable mailto:). Phone: Phone icon, number (clickable tel:). Address: MapPin icon, full address. Office hours: Clock icon, hours by day. Social links: horizontal row of social icons (Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram). Map section: aspect-video rounded-xl overflow-hidden, embedded Google Map or Mapbox, alternatively static map image with link to directions. Alternative contacts: "Need immediate help?" with link to live chat or support docs. Department contacts: if applicable, separate email/phone for Sales, Support, Press. FAQ preview: "Frequently Asked Questions" section with 3-4 common questions in accordion, "View all FAQs" link. Trust indicators: response time badge ("Average response: 4 hours"), secure form indicator. Mobile: stack columns, full-width map. Accessibility: form labels properly associated, required fields marked, error messages linked to inputs.
